History to Voat

Back in the day, I used to get off on the way Digg users would put their differences aside while working independently, yet still manage to work as a team. ie, Nobody has posted a mirror link yet, I better get onto that. Everybody that came across the mirror link would automatically up-vote it to push it to the top, so those that were region locked didn't have to go looking for it, it also stop people asking for it. Easy thing to do, also a selfless gesture created by the users for the users. Most people understood the rules as well. It was like the up-vote at Digg was primarily used to advance everybody's understanding or make things easier where possible for others. Where as at reddit, the up-vote feels more like it is used to promote ones own opinion/agenda first, then if the stars are aligned and you are holding the the amulet of first comment, you have a chance of catching the karma train which goes nowhere.

I also found it slightly amusing that reddit was like the middle ground of Digg and 4chan. In this regard, 4chan was all dog eat dog in the form of pup killers wolves . Reddit seemed to rain cats and dogs with good a chance of sloth or possibly even a narwhal if you stayed up late enough using bacon as bait. While Digg would present an expose on the weather and wildlife at reddit and how it makes the wolf pups over at 4chan anxious to feed, but can't, because wolf pups only play fight around mum and dad until they become admins and coders for Pornhub and Exon, at which point they become reddit mods and brigade voters. ;) The lols.

And now we have Voat.co, thanks to Atko and his extended team of expert goats that actually care about the Voat.co community and help where possible. Then there is you, the fresh kids to the voat goat. Tired of double standards, lame excuses and mystery shadow bans, and now here because its real, interactive and works like it should. That said, to me, it almost feels that the cycle is now complete and reset to, freedom to explore/exrpess. And also that people are once again working towards an identifiable goal and putting their differences aside for the common good. Ahh, feels good. Feels like home.

So here's to you Voat, for now and the future.
